author: RedDiver
quote:
This game officially lets George RR Martin off the hook. While Winds of Winter may never arrive, if it ever does, there is no way it will be as big a soulless disappointment as this. 

They really spent over decade taking features away. The map got bigger, the game got smaller. 

And building the whole story of the game around you pining after your girlfriend who's half-HR-Karen/half-ratchet-chola has to be one of the biggest fails in gaming history. I typically stay out of the culture war stuff as both sides annoy me to no avail, but the so called chuds are right this time. 

I would pass. or wait until next year when you can buy the game on a black friday sale at pennies on the dollar. It's not going anywhere.
